ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are five gray isosceles right triangles of the same size, arranged in sequence along the same horizontal line, with the triangles alternating up and down. The horizontal side of each triangle is on the same straight line, and the five horizontal sides together correspond to the total length 30 cm marked below. Reasoning: Because the five isosceles right triangles are congruent, their horizontal side lengths are equal. The total horizontal length is 30 cm, divided equally by five equal horizontal sides, so the horizontal side of each triangle, that is, the hypotenuse of the isosceles right triangle, has length 30/5 = 6 cm. If an isosceles right triangle has hypotenuse 6 cm, then each right-angle side is 6/√2. The area of one triangle is (1/2)(6/√2)^2 = 9 cm². There are 5 such triangles in total, so the total area of the shaded part is 5 × 9 = 45 cm².

raw_record.question_text: The figure in the drawing consists of five isosceles right triangles of the same size. Find the area (in $\mathrm{cm}^{2}$) of the shaded figure.

method.method_draft: Read the drawing as five congruent shaded isosceles right triangles placed consecutively along one horizontal line, with their horizontal bases together spanning the labeled 30 cm distance. Since the five equal horizontal bases partition the 30 cm span, each base/hypotenuse is 30/5 = 6 cm. In an isosceles right triangle whose hypotenuse is 6, each leg is 6/√2, so the area of one triangle is (1/2)(6/√2)^2 = 9 cm². Multiply by the five congruent shaded triangles to get 45 cm².

method.method_draft: From the image, treat the shaded figure as five triangular regions whose horizontal bases form the entire 30 cm segment. Because the triangles are congruent, each horizontal base is 6 cm. For an isosceles right triangle with horizontal hypotenuse 6 cm, the altitude from the right-angle vertex to the hypotenuse is half the hypotenuse, so the height is 3 cm. Instead of finding legs, add areas using total base length: total shaded area = (1/2)·(sum of the five bases)·(common height) = (1/2)·30·3 = 45 cm².
